name: Mariner's Eye Patch — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Mariner's Eye Patch from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Mariner’s Eyepatch" but are not part of the Mariner's Eye Patch entry, which is unchanged.

DESCRIPTION

This pirate’s eyepatch is heavily encrusted with jewels and arcane writing. Upon uttering a command word, the eyepatch allows the wearer to use one of the following abilities once per day as a 5th-level caster: scorching ray, see invisibility, comprehend languages.

Note: A mariner’s eyepatch uses up your entire eyes slot. You may not use another item (even another mariner’s eyepatch) that also uses the eyes slot.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, scorching ray, see invisibility, comprehend languages; Cost 6,000 gp.
